result.brief: 提出 ExecutionBridge，从规划-执行轨迹对推断控制器执行特性，并据此适配冻结世界模型的 ego 潜空间 rollout，缓解规划-执行差距，提升 NAVSIM 上未见控制器配置的规划表现。
result.reason: Adapts frozen world-model planner latents to controller-induced execution shift; contributes to world-model latent rollout adaptation for planning, though primarily a robotics/autonomous-driving application.
